integrity.verification: An embedded standard-library verifier recomputes all 15 exact class traces and the Specht multiplicities.

scientific_limitations: Rational homology representations only; no integral homology or homotopy-type assertion.
Exactly seven ground points; not a uniform result for larger Kneser graphs.
Uses the published rational Betti-number theorem and published independent embedded top classes as explicit premises.
Equivalent unindexed equivariant analyses remain possible.
title: The full \(\mathfrak S_7\)-homology character of pairwise-intersecting triples
